summary: Enhance your skills with our Market Research and Product Development Course. Learn essential strategies to drive innovation and success in your projects.
lede: Market research is the structured use of customer, market, and competitor evidence to guide product decisions. For product managers, researchers, and innovation or marketing teams, this training develops a practical workflow for defining research questions, selecting qualitative or quantitative methods, and assessing market opportunities. You will practice interview and survey design, product concept validation, evidence analysis, and feature prioritization for a product roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support customer, market, proposition, and product decisions and need a practical research-to-roadmap workflow.
modules: Market Research and Product Development Foundations
Survey Data and Digital Research Workflows
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with customers, products, services, or commercial decisions. No programming experience is required. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for the analysis exercises. Advanced concepts such as conjoint analysis and AI-assisted synthesis receive introductory operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
